name: mmpadel
description: Web de captación de MMPadel (WordPress): tema mmpadel y plugin mmpadel-core.

scripts.setup: node dev/wp-env.js run cli wp language core install es_ES --activate && node dev/wp-env.js run cli wp rewrite structure /%postname%/ --hard && node dev/wp-env.js run cli wp theme activate mmpadel && node dev/wp-env.js run cli wp option update timezone_string Europe/Madrid
scripts.mail: node dev/wp-env.js run cli cat wp-content/mmpadel-mail.log
scripts.lint:install: node dev/wp-env.js run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/mmpadel composer install
